business_problem: Fireworks AI needed a vector database that could supply grounded enterprise context to generative AI models, reduce hallucinations, support customer-controlled deployments, and avoid forcing sensitive data into disconnected third-party vector systems.
solution_summary: Fireworks AI uses MongoDB Atlas as the vector database foundation alongside its inference platform so enterprise customers can add grounded retrieval to generative AI deployments without moving sensitive data into separate systems. Document collections and other enterprise content are ingested into Atlas, embedded and indexed for MongoDB Atlas Vector Search, and then retrieved at query time to supply context to Fireworks AI-hosted or self-deployed models. This architecture supports core workloads such as conversational RAG, semantic classification, image-to-structured-data extraction, and alert intelligence while preserving data sovereignty because deployments can run inside customer environments. By pairing Atlas's native vector retrieval with Fireworks AI's high-throughput model-serving stack, the company offers a faster, lower-latency, and lower-cost path to enterprise-ready AI applications than disconnected inference and data layers.
